lessons_used: Reordering sign-in steps has been helpful overall (+4.6% average after noise correction), winning 2 of 3 tests while 1 test showed no clear effect.
Home redesign changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.1% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for finish new_screen, sign_in redesign, and adoption redesign changes, as only 1 test has been completed for each kind.
Predictions have generally been too high, though round 7 was underestimated.

candidates.title: Full bleed story screen intro redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the story intro screen with a full bleed layout and playful pet mascot to boost initial engagement.
candidates.why: choose_path step drops 23.8% of users with a high mean completion time of 514s.

story.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Bring a charming virtual friend right onto your workspace desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigns the story screen while continuing to introduce the pet within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Redesigns have shown negative average lift in tests and lack support email evidence.

candidates.title: Interactive welcome splash screen
candidates.change: Add a new welcome splash screen before story to set expectations and introduce pet choices.
candidates.why: Initial onboarding drop-off at choose_path is 23.8%, indicating a need for a clearer app intro.

new_welcome_splash.headline: Welcome to Desktop Pets
new_welcome_splash.body: Your new virtual companion is ready to be discovered.

guard.reason: Adds a valid onboarding welcome screen without omitting any required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens previously hurt conversion (-6.5%) and adds friction.

candidates.title: Choose path screen helper hint
candidates.change: Display a clear hint on the choose path screen explaining the difference between premade and custom pets.
candidates.why: Mean time for choose_path is 514s compared to median 8s, suggesting confusion for some users during path selection.

choose_path.hint: Select premade pets for instant setup or custom pet to upload your own photos.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful hint to choose path while preserving the options to adopt or make a custom pet.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost configuration hint addressing large disparity between median and mean completion time.

candidates.title: Sign-in progress indicator and notification toggle
candidates.change: Enable progress bar and background notification toggle on the sign-in screen.
candidates.why: Support received 2 emails reporting sign-in stalling and 8 emails about account sync confusion.

sign_in.hint: Signing in syncs your pet state safely across sessions.

guard.reason: Enhances the sign-in screen with progress and notification options within allowed onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Backed by 10 support emails detailing sign-in stalling and sync confusion.

candidates.title: Carousel layout redesign for pick friend screen
candidates.change: Redesign the pick friend screen into a dynamic carousel layout with enlarged live pet previews.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and median time of 89s.

guard.reason: Redesigns the pick friend screen into a carousel layout while preserving pet selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: Target step has highest drop-off but adoption redesign previously saw a -7.5% drop.

candidates.title: Guided custom pet photo upload flow
candidates.change: Upgrade photo upload screen with a photo picker tool and tip carousel to ensure high photo quality.
candidates.why: Support logged 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong during adoption.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Use clear lighting and front-facing pet photos for best generation results.

guard.reason: Upgrades the photo upload flow with tools and tips while retaining its required job.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step backed by 3 support emails regarding custom pet creation issues.

candidates.title: Adoption certificate confirmation button copy update
candidates.change: Update adoption certificate screen headline and action button label for clearer step progression.
candidates.why: Over 39% of users drop off during the adoption flow before reaching waiting screen.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your pet choice is finalized. Proceed to prepare its desktop home!

guard.reason: Updates text on the adoption certificate screen without removing required functionality or stamp.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak addressing the step with the highest drop-off rate (39.1%).

candidates.title: Generation timer and progress display on waiting screen
candidates.change: Add an estimated time display, progress bar, and automatic tip delay to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s (median 201s), causing user uncertainty.

guard.reason: Adds real wait progress and estimation indicators to the waiting screen as allowed by Rule 4 and Rule 5.

candidates.score_note: Targets extreme mean wait time (2336s) on home waiting screen with progress feedback.

candidates.title: Spotlight layout redesign for desktop waiting screen
candidates.change: Redesign waiting screen with a spotlight layout featuring an animated pet status indicator.
candidates.why: 3 support mails report pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to open during desktop prep.

waiting.headline: Setting Up Desktop Workspace
waiting.body: Your pet companion is being placed on your desktop. It will appear momentarily!

guard.reason: Redesigns waiting screen while continuing to convey that the pet is being prepared.

candidates.score_note: Backed by desktop support emails but home redesigns consistently underperform (-3.1%).

candidates.title: Home intro desktop controls copy update
candidates.change: Update home intro copy with clear desktop interaction instructions and tray icon hints.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and support received 3 emails about unclear controls/hiding/talking to pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Drag to move your pet around screen. Right click to access pet actions and settings.
home_intro.hint: Minimize or manage your pet anytime via the system tray icon.

guard.reason: Updates home intro copy with desktop usage instructions within onboarding boundaries.

candidates.score_note: Config-only copy update targeting 35.2% drop-off step with 3 supporting user emails.

decisions.title: Guided custom pet photo upload flow

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in steps has been helpful overall (+4.6% average after noise correction), winning 2 of 3 tests while 1 test showed no clear effect.
Home redesign changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.1% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for finish new_screen, sign_in redesign, adoption redesign, and adoption new_flow changes, as only 1 test has been completed for each kind.
Predictions have generally been too high, though round 7 was underestimated.
